__inputs.name: INPUT_GATEWAY_JOB_NAME
__inputs.label: Gateway job name (app.kubernetes.io/instance by default)
__inputs.description: The name of the gateway to monitor

description: Per-stage request lifecycle latency broken down by Kafka API key (ADR-0015).

options.content: Per lifecycle span: **mean / max / rate**, one line per API key. Use the **API key** dropdown above to filter which keys are shown. Requires `GATEWAY_FEATURE_FLAGS_LIFECYCLE_METRICS=true`.

panels.description: Mean latency by api_key for preprocess (T0→T1).

targets.expr: sum by(api_key) (rate(gateway_request_preprocess_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by(api_key) (rate(gateway_request_preprocess_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))
